findings.name: STAFF_FIRST_PLAYER_LOGIN
findings.conclusion: BLOCKER: existing LINE identity without users row is not reused by player login

findings.name: PLAYER_FIRST_DUAL_PURPOSE
findings.conclusion: Existing tables support player-first dual-purpose sessions; staff-first orchestration is missing

findings.name: MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION
findings.conclusion: Current owner authorization is legitimate; generic merchant session cannot represent the NEW staff-only branch ceiling. Not an existing unauthorized cross-brand exploit.

findings.name: INVITATION_SESSION_SCOPE
findings.conclusion: Existing invite/session rows lack staff-specific branch, membership, provider provenance. Legacy redemption remains invitation-only when Google flag is OFF; a future staff invite must not fall back to it.

findings.name: SUBJECT_CONFLICT
findings.conclusion: DB prevents duplicate subject; future login must explicitly return ACCOUNT_LINK_CONFLICT without merge

findings.name: LEGACY_GLOBAL_REDEMPTION_READ
findings.conclusion: Separate existing route exposure: staff rollout cannot claim branch-only data access while this unscoped read remains. No real player data was accessed.
